hints.title: Longest Common Prefix Equivalence
hints.text: The score of the k-th built string equals the length of the longest common prefix between s and the suffix of s starting at index n - k.

hints.title: Z-Function Formulation
hints.text: The Z-array of string s precisely stores Z[i], the length of the longest common prefix between s and s[i..n-1].

hints.title: Full String Contribution
hints.text: Summing Z[i] for all 1 <= i < n plus n (for s itself at i = 0) yields the total score.

hints.title: Linear Z-Algorithm Implementation

complexity.notes: Z-algorithm computes prefix matches in linear time using a sliding match window [l, r].
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing prefixes naively takes O(n^2) operations and TLEs for n up to 10^5.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate recognizes Z-algorithm or KMP failure function application.
